statement: Broadcom guided full-year fiscal 2026 AI semiconductor revenue to approximately $58 billion, up 186% year over year.
why: Custom accelerator revenue at this scale shows hyperscaler AI spending is still expanding fast and is increasingly routed to in-house silicon rather than merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Strong AI silicon guidance confirms overall accelerator demand while shifting a growing share of that spend to custom XPUs that compete with merchant GPUs for the same foundry and HBM capacity.

evidence.excerpt: Broadcom guided full-year fiscal 2026 AI semiconductor revenue to approximately $58 billion (up 186% from the prior year)

confidence.basis: Secondary paraphrase of the earnings call; the official transcript page could not be fetched.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 21.7 -> 58.0 (tol 1%); sources: Broadcom Inc. (official press release via PR Newswire), Yahoo Finance
